outcome: Non-remodeled spiral arteries without intramural trophoblast
cohort: A total of 270 women, including 121 women undergoing Caesarian section for Preeclampsia and/or Fetal Growth Restriction and a reference group of 149 healthy controls.
finding: Preeclampsia and Fetal Growth Restriction are associated with a significantly higher prevalence of impaired physiological remodeling and vascular lesions of the uterine spiral arteries in the placental bed compared to healthy controls.
